common_settings.weight_rule: duration = end - start; no task generation, slicing, rescheduling within access or reward reassignment
common_settings.edge_rule: order u,v by (start,id); edge iff (same antenna and start_v < end_u + ground_gap) or (same satellite and start_v < end_u + satellite_gap); all overlaps including containment are conflicts
common_settings.horizon_contact_policy: keep only unmodified full contacts fully contained in the planning horizon; retain crossing intervals separately
common_settings.tick_note: fixed serialization only; not a statement of orbital accuracy; do not coarsen to manufacture feature equality; check integer overflow

P3_not_scheduled.warning: explicit allocation alternatives; prevent duplicate reward using satellite capacity-one

source_group_policy: all derived station views, geometry companions, gaps, scopes and snapshots from one physical realization remain in one split
